reviewed_commit.description: The sha of the commit this review record actually examined. A record whose reviewed_commit is not the current head of the branch under review is STALE and must not satisfy the gate: a PR's code changes underneath a record keyed only to a PR number, so a review of an earlier round cannot stand in for a review of the current one.

reviewer_was_dispatched_by_author.description: Required, and enforced, for records whose typed 'pr' is >= scripts/lwb_lanes.REVIEWER_ID_FORMAT_CUTOFF_PR (19). Declares -- self-attested, not verified -- whether the reviewer identity was a subagent/dispatch of the author's own session. `true` does not fail the gate (the gate cannot tell a genuinely independent reviewer from one that simply declares itself independent), but scripts/lwb_lanes.py prints a NOTICE for it so the record is never silently read as proof of independence. See reviews/README.md.
